name: Corondor
description: A small continent where most documented conflict occurred.

description_citations.text: "Time of Legends". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dakkon forges the Blackblade, sacrificing his own blood, then his son Daron, then countless slaves over the following years.
timeline.quote: Dakkon plunged the white-hot metal into his own son's chest.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geyadrone receives the Blackblade and steals Dakkon's soul by stabbing his shadow with the sword.
timeline.quote: she stabbed Dakkon's shadow on the ground, treacherously stealing his soul with the sword

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel lures six planeswalkers to Corondor with the Mox Beacon and forces them to battle in the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Ravidel used an artifact known as the Mox Beacon to lure other planeswalkers to Corondor.

citation.text: "Corondor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around the New Phyrexian Invasion Corondor falls under Geyadrone Dihada's control again.
timeline.quote: the island fell back under the control of Geyadrone Dihada

citation.text: "Corondor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Son of Carth escapes Dihada's dungeons and uses the Amulet of Ti-Fu to bind himself to Dakkon.
timeline.quote: The boy (known as the Son of Carth ) used the Amulet of Ti-Fu to bind himself to Dakkon

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade-Dihada War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dakkon bests Sol'Kanar, banishes Chromium and kills Piru with the Blackblade, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
timeline.quote: This released a massive energy blast that created the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor .

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade-Dihada War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dihada reveals the monk was herself, absorbs Piru's soul, and her glyph steals Dakkon's spark and binds him to her for eternity.
timeline.quote: She then revealed to Carth that the monk who had set Carth on his quest was none other than Dihada herself.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade-Dihada War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dihada corrupts Sol'Kanar and sets about conquering Corondor.
timeline.quote: set about conquering Corondor

citation.text: "Geyadrone Dihada", section "Dihada's schemes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dihada leaves Dominaria and reappears at the Planeswalkers' War.
timeline.quote: Afterward, she left Dominaria

citation.text: "Geyadrone Dihada", section "Dihada's schemes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As a young Corondor girl, Sivitri attempts to drown herself but instead sparks to the Dragon Stronghold.
timeline.quote: One day she attempted to drown herself, but instead sparked to the Dragon Stronghold.

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sivitri raids southeastern Corondor with her dragon horde; refugees' weapons prove useless.
timeline.quote: Sivitri raided southeastern Corondor with her horde of dragons on several occasions.

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Sivitri's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A healer brews a poppy poison created by Sol'Kanar that kills dozens of Scarzam dragons, and Sivitri leaves Dominaria for other conquests.
timeline.quote: Dozens of the creatures were killed before Sivitri

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Sivitri's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sivitri raids southeastern Corondor with dragons until poppy poison from Sol'Kanar kills the Scarzam Dragons and she leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Before Sivitri, astride the last and largest Scarzam Dragon, dozens of creatures were killed, leaving Dominaria for other planar conquests.

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Sivitri's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dakkon defeats Sol'Kanar, whom Dihada then discards as she tricks Dakkon into becoming her champion.
timeline.quote: He was defeated by Dakkon

citation.text: "Sol'Kanar", section "Minion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Altair is bound to the land, stripped of planeswalker abilities and memory.
timeline.quote: stripped of his planeswalker abilities

citation.text: "The Gathering", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Elder Druid of Corondor finds Jared with Yorgo's help and warns of the coming war while Jared tends to Kristina as she gives birth to Justina.
timeline.quote: The Elder Druid, revealing that he bore the crescent-moon Mark of the Elder Druid, warned of the coming war and the necessity of preparation.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise interrupts the Lord of House Khone's war council, and together they bind Sol'Kanar the Swamp King.
timeline.quote: Together, they summoned and bound Sol’Kanar the Swamp King

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kristina reappears, having lost her planeswalker spark; she and Jared choose mortal lives and Jared accepts becoming Elder Druid.
timeline.quote: She had managed to escape the explosion but had lost her Planeswalker spark in the process.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir reconciles with Sandruu, and Teferi and Eskil free Daria from the Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Teferi retrieved Daria's Amber Prison, and with Eskil’s help, freed her at last.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared and Sandruu duel in Castle Melmereth; Jared escapes with Dihada's spellbook.
timeline.quote: Still, Jared manages to evade Sandruu long enough to escape with the spellbook.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi refuses Leshrac's recruitment and sends Caliphear to warn Freyalise.
timeline.quote: Leshrac then steals some artifacts and spells from the island, ensuring that his visit is not a waste of time.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir arrives in Corondor, seeks Kristina, and flees on learning she has another lover.
timeline.quote: Realizing that Kristina has taken yet another lover, Taysir flees, hurt and confused.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szat defeats Jared and steals the Red Mana Battery.
timeline.quote: Jared is then assaulted by Tevesh Szat, who quickly defeats him and steals his Red Mana Battery

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel tries to recruit Jared for his crusade against planeswalkers and leaves Justina unharmed.
timeline.quote: Ravidel tries to recruit Jared for his crusade to eliminate all the other planeswalkers

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian gremlins grab the Mox Beacon and haul it to Phyrexia to destroy it after Taysir opens a door to the Hell of Artifice.
timeline.quote: Numerous Phyrexian gremlin rush out and grab the Beacon, then haul it over to Phyrexia to destroy it.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kristina is revealed alive but burned and sparkless.
timeline.quote: Kristina is badly burned from the damage, and her planeswalker spark is now missing.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared becomes the next Elder Druid, giving up planeswalkerhood.
timeline.quote: Jared acknowledges his destiny and becomes the next Elder Druid, willingly giving up his planeswalkerhood.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi retrieves the Amber Prison and Eskil releases Daria.
timeline.quote: Teferi retrieves the Amber Prison from the Null Moon and Eskil releases Daria from it.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Elder Druid finds Jared with Yorgo's help as Kristina gives birth to Justina, and announces he has come to prepare others for war.
timeline.quote: Kristina gives birth to a daughter, and they name her Justina .

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Crescent Moon , by Jeff Gomez". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eskil reveals Ravidel created the Mox Beacon, and Embereck agrees to fight him.
timeline.quote: Embereck agrees to fight

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Dragon's Dance , by David Quinn , Kenny Martinez and Anibal Rodriguez". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel enrages Sandruu with out-of-context images of Jared and Kristina, sending him to find Jared.
timeline.quote: This is enough to send Sandruu into a rage

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Wishes, Lies & Dreams , by D. G. Chichester and Mark Buckingham". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Elder Druid tells Jared he must choose between the land and the stars.
timeline.quote: The druid tells Jared that he must choose between the land and the stars.

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Dark Horizons , by Jeff Gomez". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel attacks the Summit of Minorad and uses the Sylex to blackmail several planeswalkers into servitude.
timeline.quote: Ravidel attacked this Summit of Minorad and hatched an insidious plan

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The summit of Minorad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Only Embereck refuses Ravidel's demand and vanishes with a vow of vengeance.
timeline.quote: Only Embereck refused and vanished with a vow of vengeance against Ravidel.

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The summit of Minorad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel tells Taysir that Kristina has taken a lover, provoking Taysir to attack Sandruu.
timeline.quote: Ravidel gleefully brought him the news that Kristina had taken a lover

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Manipulating Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel corrupts Lord Adam Carthalion and kills him at the Battle of Aster Fall.
timeline.quote: He corrupted Lord Adam Carthalion and eventually killed him at the Battle of Aster Fall

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Gathering power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana and Altair die at Ravidel's hands, and he secures the Moxes.
timeline.quote: died at Ravidel's hands

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Gathering power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel plans to activate a Mox Beacon to draw his enemies to Dominaria, and succeeds in drawing Szat to Corondor, starting the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: Ravidel was destined to succeed in drawing Szat to Corondor

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The planeswalker war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared, taught by Kristina and her lover, leads the fight against Ravidel.
timeline.quote: Jared was taught by Kristina and became her lover

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The planeswalker war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared sends Ulf with the book to Corondor while he returns to the academy.
timeline.quote: "You will take the book to safety. Bring it to Corondor.

citation.text: "The Education of Ulf" by Brian Evenson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: In 4562 Dihada returns to Dominaria, takes the Tolarian Academy and Corondor, hoping to force Jared Carthalion into a conflict that returns Dakkon to her.
timeline.quote: In 4562, Dihada returned to Dominaria to take control of the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam .

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The boy, imprisoned for trying to assassinate Dihada, is teleported by the Mad Monk into her library and steals a grimoire and the Amulet of Ti-Fu.
timeline.quote: The Monk then teleported the boy into Dihada’s library

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The boy summons Dakkon, who is bound by the Amulet from killing him until Dihada is slain.
timeline.quote: When the boy summoned him, Dakkon was far from pleased.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a skirmish with Dihada nearly kills the boy, Dakkon saves him and they become friends.
timeline.quote: Dakkon intervened to save him, and an unlikely friendship grew between them.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dihada returns with Sol'Kanar and two Elder Dragons; Dakkon slays Sol'Kanar and banishes Chromium.
timeline.quote: Dakkon slew Sol’Kanar and banished Chromium

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The boy recovers the Blackblade and passes it to Dakkon, who uses it to kill Piru.
timeline.quote: Dakkon used the blade to kill Piru.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: It is revealed that Dihada, disguised as the Mad Monk, orchestrated everything; she absorbs Piru's energy and seals Dakkon to her will.
timeline.quote: She had been disguised as the Mad Monk who had first set the boy on his quest.

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sol'Kanar submerges the caravan path between Khone and Shikar and uses it as leverage to demand tribute.
timeline.quote: By deliberately submerging this critical trade artery beneath the waters of his swamp

citation.text: "Date of Tribute", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Khone and Shikar must send regular offerings under threat of destruction, and are called the Contrary Kingdoms.
timeline.quote: the two kingdoms were compelled to send regular offerings directly to him

citation.text: "Date of Tribute", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The tribute becomes one spellcaster per realm; Gydolien Mor and Chondaeh are sent into Sol'Kanar's service, precipitating the Dragon War.
timeline.quote: Their involvement directly precipitated the outbreak of the Dragon War

citation.text: "Date of Tribute", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel survives but loses control of Corondor; Jared departs as a Wayfarer.
timeline.quote: his control over Corondor was shattered

citation.text: "Fall of Castle Melmereth", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elvish refugees from the Brothers' War found the Quirion Sovereign in the White Woods.
timeline.quote: elvish refugees traveled to Corondor and founded the Sovereign in its White Woods

citation.text: "Quirion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Both exarchs meet the Great Spirit with Jared Carthalion and Kristina of the Woods.
timeline.quote: both exarchs met with the force of nature together with Jared Carthalion and Kristina of the Woods

citation.text: "Quirion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sivitri, astride her dragons, descends on southeastern Corondor with her horde, causing panic.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Sivitri Scarzam descended upon the lush lands of southeastern Corondor

citation.text: "Sivitri's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An aged healer finds a new poppy created by Sol'Kanar that makes a poison killing Scarzam Dragons.
timeline.quote: the poppies became an incredibly potent contact poison that could kill the Scarzam Dragons

citation.text: "Sivitri's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sivitri leaves the plane on the largest dragon and the last remaining dragons are destroyed.
timeline.quote: left the plane for other planar conquests

citation.text: "Sivitri's War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xarl forces Skule to summon the Serra Angel Trine and binds her with the Horned Halo, starting her 326-year enslavement.
timeline.quote: This started the 326-year-long enslavement of Trine .

citation.text: "Xarl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xarl uses Trine's power to rise to great power and has her forget being an angel of Serra.
timeline.quote: he magically caused Trine to forget her past as an angel of Serra

citation.text: "Xarl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
